mode.title: Mode
mode.description: auto: buy the longer cache tier once this conversation has shown it pauses long enough to lose the short one. short: always leave the harness default. long: always buy the longer tier. off: never touch breakpoints.

min_gap_seconds_for_long_tier.title: Min Gap For Long Tier (seconds)
min_gap_seconds_for_long_tier.description: How long an observed pause must be before the longer tier is bought. 0 uses 30% of that tier's lifetime, so one unusual pause does not commit a short conversation.
